scope.claim: prospective development-only identification of real continuous backbone-ranking opportunity panels
scope.question: Do two independently selected real structured targets contain recoverable nonlinear head advantage that materially changes backbone rankings relative to a linear probe?
scope.future_gate: a later ranker experiment requires at least two admitted datasets and a separately frozen protocol before reserved-backbone outcomes

source.pretraining_overlap_warning: the official source warns that CUB images overlap ImageNet

cub_200_2011_beak_tail.eligibility: beak and tail visibility flags both equal 1; finite distinct coordinates; positive finite bounding-box width and height

cohort.stratification: exactly two eligible official-training images per species per replicate and four eligible official-test images per species
cohort.shortfall_policy: fail closed if any species lacks six eligible training or four eligible testing images

source.availability_note: original project host was unreachable before acquisition; use the explicitly pinned public rehost

lsp_2000_pose.split: images im0001-im1000 are training; im1001-im2000 are evaluation
lsp_2000_pose.visibility_semantics: the third joint channel is treated as an occlusion flag: 0 is eligible and 1 is excluded

target_recipes.torso_axis_sine: y component of the unit vector from hip midpoint to shoulder midpoint in image coordinates
target_recipes.torso_axis_cosine: x component of the unit vector from hip midpoint to shoulder midpoint in image coordinates
target_recipes.bilateral_knee_extension_cosine: negative mean of left and right cosines between the knee-to-hip and knee-to-ankle vectors; a straight leg approaches +1

eligibility.torso_axis_sine: right/left hips and shoulders all have occlusion flag 0 and define a nonzero finite torso vector
eligibility.bilateral_knee_extension_cosine: both hips, knees, and ankles have occlusion flag 0 and all four limb segments have nonzero finite length

cohort.selection: deterministic SHA-256 order within ten source-split quantile strata; torso sine/cosine share strata defined by torso angle and knee extension uses its own target quantiles
cohort.shortfall_policy: fail closed unless each target supports 600 unique training rows and 500 evaluation rows

backbones.weights: exact cached pretrained checkpoint specifications already hash-locked by prior real-image panels

preprocessing.image: raw RGB image with each extractor's frozen native preprocessing
preprocessing.pca_fit_scope: training rows only per dataset, target, seed, and scout backbone

heads.selection: three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV maximizing R2, followed by fixed-cohort evaluation

opportunity_definition.envelope: maximum held-out test R2 over the four frozen head families

admission.target_rule: all three base checks and at least one rank-change check must pass
admission.dataset_rule: at least one frozen target passes the target rule
admission.experiment_rule: both independent datasets pass before any later OI-ranker comparison

reporting.runtime: head fitting time is descriptive and not a promotion criterion
reporting.pretraining_overlap: both datasets are discovery-only because pretrained-source overlap cannot be excluded
